item.title: Futures of Global Catastrophic Risks and Societal Collapse
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines potential futures shaped by global catastrophic risks and the possibility of societal collapse. The call invites research exploring how these existential threats might reshape human societies and what alternative futures could emerge from confronting such challenges.

Appel publié par Futures. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
